Restaurant Linear Layout

Mission 2, laid out from your scenario as 9 streamed sections: a street where the informant gives up the passport maker, the restaurant where he's recognised, then the block behind it. That's storage, safe rooms, a workshop, a safe house and a print shop, stitched together by back lanes and alleys rather than hallways. Two loops. The courtyard where the lanes meet is crossed west to east, then met again from the north after the roofs and the flats (F8). The back alleys, 4.5 m between houses as the arena's, ring a block and come back round to their first corner from the north (F14). The restaurant is a wave encounter: a cutscene gets the customers out, then kill 11 across three waves and the barred kitchen door opens. No civilians in play. The longest sightline in any fight space is 24.5 m, and the street's is 25.0 m (both measured with a 1.2 m-wide line). Story beats are inspects: the informant, the document lab, the passport maker. Gunmen and pickups are rough guides; the layout is what gets built.

Upper floor · +3.5 m

storeys 3.5 m (Lvl_01_Slum's) · grey = the floor below · the roof and the plank are open, with a parapet

Section 5 goes over the lane and back down. Up the storage hall's stair into rooms they hold (F5), round the floor and out of the safe room onto the workshop's flat roof (F6). A plank crosses the 3 m lane to a knocked-out window in the flats next door (F7), and their stair comes down by the front door. The lane you'll walk next is under the plank.

Loop 1, the courtyard: the first time, it's ahead of you as you come out of a roofed lane. The second time you come out of a front door on its north side, they're waiting in the lane you came in by, and the wave comes from the chained gate and the kitchen.

Loop 2, the back alleys: out of the burn yard's side gate, west along the first alley, south, west under a lean-to, north into a half-court where they make a stand (F13), then east to the safe house's side door. That's the first alley's corner again, seen from the north through a chained gate. Their wave opens it from the side you came in by (F14). Both loops follow your rule of 2026-11-12: back to a place from another entrance, for a new fight.

The safe house and the print shop: the safe house goes up its front stair, round the floor, and down a wooden back stair into a back room they've knocked through into the print shop's front, with shelving right inside the hole. The presses behind the shut shop front are being pulled apart (F17); upstairs is the document lab (F18, I7). The office door is barred until the lab is clear, and the passport maker is in there (I9). His office opens onto a steel side stair down to a lane and a gate onto the next street: the way out (I10).

Sections + streaming

one persistent map, sections as tags until streaming is built (as Lvl_01_Slum)

Streaming: As Mission 1, but the loops make the sections a graph, not a line: the courtyard (3) borders the restaurant, storage, the flats and the workshop. Loaded is the section you're in and every section it borders. The workshop's roof is walked in 5 but belongs to the workshop's building, so 6 loads with 5 as well. The alleys (7) are one section: their ring comes back to its own start. A border door holds until the section behind it is loaded, unloading waits until you're a few metres past a door, and a section remembers what's done. That memory matters more here: the courtyard and the alleys' first corner are each fought twice, and the second fight must not bring back the first one's dead. A death reloads only the current section's gameplay from its last checkpoint.

The generator has to learn

  1. A restaurant: a dining room with an open shop front, a counter, a kitchen. Check the packs (Philippines_Markets first) for tables, monobloc chairs, a counter, stoves and steel prep tables.
  2. The arena's alleys, laid as a chain: 4.5 m lanes with their dressing rules (wires, laundry, pipes, AC units, meters, posters), a lean-to over part of one, and a half-court pocket with a sari-sari stall.
  3. A walkable flat roof with a parapet and water tanks, over a one-storey building.
  4. A plank bridge across a 3 m lane into a knocked-out window.
  5. An outside steel stair down a building's side (the way out).
  6. A print shop and a document lab: presses, a guillotine, paper stacks, a light table, a laminator. Probably no pack has these, so they may need sourcing.
  7. Shut shop fronts on the far street (shutters down), as the slum's.
  8. Everything else is Mission 1's: rooms per storey, openings, stairs, lanes, compound walls, sections as tags.

New gameplay it needs

  • A talk inspect: the informant is a person, not an object, and money changes hands.
  • The recognition cutscene (yours, 2026-11-13): he's recognised and the customers and staff are got out in the cutscene. No live civilians, so F1 starts on its end.
  • Wave encounters (yours, 2026-11-13): waves from set doors, a cap on how many are up at once, and a kill count that fires an event. F1's opens the barred kitchen door. Mission 1's fights have a single top-up wave; this is the general version.
  • Gunmen busy with something: carrying boxes (F4), burning papers (F10), pulling a press apart (F17), until they see him.
  • Gates opened by the enemy (F8's and F14's waves unchain them), and a door unbarred by an event (his office, after I7).
  • Graph streaming: a section that borders four others (the courtyard), and the roof's building loading with the section above it.
  • A non-hostile NPC for the passport maker, cornered: the interrogation is a mini cutscene (I9).

Layout calls I made

  • F1's waves: 4 at the tables, 4 in at the front off the street, 3 down a stair from the family's rooms; kill 11, at most 5 up.
  • The courtyard is the first loop's mid room; the back alleys' first corner is the second's.
  • Both loops' ways on are chained gates their wave opens, so the order holds without locking anything behind you.
  • The alleys are one section: a ring, every leg 15 m or less, the half-court the widest place.
  • The burn yard's side gate is in a wall, with an owner-type jeep just inside: no line from the yard down the first alley.
  • The safe house's back room is knocked through into the print shop: the "improvised connection between properties", with the plank.
  • The print shop's shop front faces the far street, shut: the business is a front on both sides of the block.
  • His office is barred until the lab is clear, so the interrogation comes after the last fight.
  • The way out is a side stair and a gate to the next street, not back through the block.

Open — yours to call

  • The level's name (a story level, so no _Arena). Lvl_02_Restaurant would follow Lvl_01_Slum.
  • Time of day. There are customers, so it's open: lunch, or evening?
  • What kind of restaurant (a carinderia, a panciteria, something bigger), and who owns it.
  • Arms for this level, and whether anything is placed.
  • Where the informant is met, and whether he's seen again.
  • Who recognises him in the dining room.
  • The street before the fight: empty (as now, no live civilians), or ambient people the cutscene clears too?
  • Is the evidence burning on a clock (lost if you're slow), or set dressing?
  • The passport maker: does he try to run or fight first, or is he simply cornered?
  • The end: walk out by the side gate (my suggestion), or end on the interrogation.
  • What I2, I3, I4 and I5 show (my suggestions are marked).
  • The lead's name (to be decided: none in the build).
